decision: Team-lead decision 2026-10-03 (option '표시 전용'): drug-use chips with no adopted MBPI evidence may show reviewed single-compound or single-peptide literature values, labelled as not entering any score.
admission: The organism is the species (accepted name or synonym).

A single compound isolated from the species with the structure elucidated, or a single peptide identified in the species and chemically synthesized (or purified with sequence confirmed). No extracts, fractions, hydrolysates, mixtures or recombinant products.
Not a common metabolite under the 3.1 rule (fatty acids, sterols, carotenoids; Wikidata P703 taxa above the fence of 31).
A numeric value with relation '=' and its unit.
The value was read in the full text or in the curated ChEMBL activity record; abstract-only values wait in 'pending'.
scope_note: Display only: these records never enter MFPI, MBPI, MCUI, BBVI, the matrix or the map colours.
